message.content:
An editorial illustration with a solid orange background features several objects and text elements. At the top, the large black word "TEMPO" is positioned over the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above this, smaller white text reads "HAKIM KASUS JESSICA: KAMI YAKIN SIAPA PELAKUNYA" and "TARIK-ULUR LABEL HALAL".

Centrally, a dark brown, rectangular machine—resembling a paper shredder—is shredding a white piece of paper. The top of the paper shows the upper portion of a blue-toned face, while the bottom emerges from the machine in vertical strips. These strips form the rest of the blue-toned face, featuring eyes, a nose, and a mustache. 

From the right, a dark, silhouetted hand holds a silver fork. The fork is twirling the shredded strips of paper as if they were noodles.

In the lower right, large white block letters read "MUNIR MATI, SIAPA PEDULI". In the lower left, there is a white box containing a barcode, the price "RP 39.500", and the date "31 OKTOBER- 6 NOVEMBER 2016". The "TEMPO" logo with blue and white geometric shapes is also present.
